# Traffic Engine AI — Website Traffic Generator & GA4 Journey QA Studio

> Autonomous Synthetic User Journey QA, Website Traffic Simulator, Load Testing & Live GA4 Verification Platform. Run instantly in the cloud via our official Apify Store Actor (`hirepulse/website-traffic-generator`) or self-host locally via Node.js LTS & Docker Compose (`edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine`, MIT licensed).

## Cloud & Open-Source Entry Points
- [Website Traffic Generator on Apify Store](https://apify.com/hirepulse/website-traffic-generator): Managed cloud execution with Patchright, Playwright Stealth, Camoufox, built-in Apify Proxy, 20-country organic search/social referrers, `ultra_lite` bandwidth saver (~80% less data), four behavioral personas (deep reader, product shopper, funnel converter, video viewer), safe conversion-CTA clicks, on-page HTML5 video playback QA, Core Web Vitals (TTFB/FCP/P95), read-only ad-slot inventory (0 ad clicks), live GA4 `/g/collect` beacon verification, and Executive HTML Reports (`SUMMARY_REPORT.html`). Pay-Per-Event ($0.003/visit = $3.00 per 1,000 visits).
- [n8n Website Traffic & GA4 Monitor Workflow](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/assets/n8n-website-ga4-monitor-workflow.json): Ready-to-import n8n workflow — schedule the Apify Actor, fetch `OUTPUT`, and alert Slack/webhook when GA4 verification or the visit success rate drops below 100%.
- [1-Click Apify Input & Local config.json Builder](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/config-builder/): Export both 100% schema-valid Apify Actor Input JSON (`apify-input.json`) and local `config.json` in the browser, including personas, CTA/funnel, video QA and live SERP warm-up.
- [Self-Hosted GitHub Repository](https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine): Full Express UI (`127.0.0.1:4310`), live `rrweb` preview, interactive scenario recorder, and Docker Swarm worker profiles.
- [Download Source ZIP](https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine/archive/refs/heads/main.zip): Direct main branch snapshot.

## Architecture & Engineering Guides
- [Multi-Agent Hybrid AI Architecture](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/architecture/): 4 specialized worker roles, `/v1/systemone` zero-output-token routing (`clef:27b`), Playbook Caching, and HirePulse Cloud Credits failover.
- [Multi-Engine Stealth & Fingerprints](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/playwright-stealth-crawlee/): Patchright (zero CDP leak), Playwright Chromium, Camoufox, and Lightpanda CDP.
- [Limit Residential Proxy Bandwidth](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/limit-residential-bandwidth/): `ultra_lite` / `lite` asset blockers, `byteBudgetMb` hard caps, and RAM caching without breaking GA4 telemetry.
- [Geo Proxy Routing (Apify Proxy, Webshare & Decodo)](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/webshare-decodo-proxies/): 20-country locale/timezone matching and per-domain cooldown scoring.
- [Run AI Browser Agents on a Fixed Budget](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/ai-agents-budget/): Decision vs chat model split and `workerPct` tuning.
- [GA4 Hit Verification & Email OTP QA](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/ga4-otp-funnel-qa/): Verify `google-analytics.com/g/collect` hits (`G-XXXX` IDs & events) and run temporary inbox OTP sweeps.
- [Docker Swarm & Local Quickstart](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/guides/docker-swarm-setup/): Docker Compose worker scaling and Lightpanda sidecar.
